item.title: Time change for Tyrone’s clash with Down in Dr. McKenna Cup
item.description: Tyrone’s Dr. McKenna Cup Round 3 fixture against Down will now be played on Sunday at 2:15pm. The game had originally been scheduled for 1:30pm on Sunday, but will still be played at Pomeroy. Tyrone overcame Armagh in the competition opener last week so a win would see them progress to the semi-final stages. item.title: Boxing: Gallagher through to National Elite Semi-Finals
item.description: Jude Gallagher has progressed to the semi-final stages of the National Elite Championships after a victory over Martin McDonagh at the National Stadium last night. The Two Castles fighter was a unanimous 5-0 winner over his opponent from Avona in Dublin in their 60kg quarter-final.
